blocks.text: La Paz, Bolivia: city neighbourhoods in a mountain basin
Uyuni to the Uyuni Salt Flat and Tahua

Transfer to the airport early in the morning for the flight from La Paz to Uyuni. The flight is paid for separately. You’ll be met at Uyuni airport and have some free time to explore the town on your own and have breakfast.

The expedition starts at 10:00. First, visit the Train Cemetery and the village of Colchani to learn about the region’s mining history and how salt is extracted today.

Then head out onto the Uyuni Salt Flat by 4×4. See a salt hotel and museum, the small salt outcrops at Ojos de Agua and the areas where the famous mirror reflections form during the rainy season from December to March.

At noon, reach Incahuasi Island, where rocks and giant cacti rise above the salt plain. Local wildlife lives here, and the highest point offers views across the salt flat in every direction.

From Incahuasi, head to the northern part of the salt flat. Visit a local museum with pre-Columbian mummies and a viewpoint at the foot of Tunupa Volcano. Arrive in Tahua at the end of the day.

Included: one night at Hotel Tayka de Sal, private 4×4 transport, a bilingual English- and Spanish-speaking guide, admission tickets and transfers along the route. Meals: lunch and dinner.
